== The Demon Faction ==
[[File:Demon champion trophy.png|left|54x54px|Demon Champion Trophy]]
[[File:Hell-rush-spell-upgrade.png|right|Hell Rush]]
Part of the Evil Vanilla Factions, the '''Demons''' have upgrades increasing production of highest tier [[buildings]] and perks based on the amount of [[trophies]] you have. <br />Their [[Bloodline]], more used in late games, can become powerful for long reincarnations as it increases production based on total time spent being Evil. 
* '''[[Alignment]]''': '''''Evil'''''
* '''[[Alignment#Leges|Leges]]''': '''''Chaos'''''
* '''[[Spells|Faction Spell]]''': '''''Hellfire Blast''''' - Increases the production of Evil Fortresses and Hell Portals.  
* '''[[Spells#Spell Upgrades|Spell Upgrade]]''': '''''Hell Rush''''' - ''Hellfire Blast'' also boosts Halls of Legends.   
** Unlock requirement: Cast ''Hellfire Blast'' in the first 60 seconds of a playtime.  
* '''[[Heritage]]''': Increase the production of all buildings by 0.3% per Hall of Legends you own.
* '''[[Bloodline]]''': Increase production bonus from gems based on total time spent being Evil.<br />{{Formula|floor(0.04 * x^{0.8})%|your Time Spent Being Evil (Total) in seconds stat}}  
* '''[[Challenge|Challenge Reward]]''': '''''Hellfire Burst''''' - Reduces Hellfire Blast mana cost based on of the amount of trophies you have unlocked.<br />{{Formula|floor(0.25 * x)|the amount of trophies unlocked}}  
* '''[[Unique Buildings|Research Building]]''':  '''''Infernal Realms''''' (from Hell Portals)
* '''[[Research#Research#The Facilities & Related Factions|Research Facility]]''': '''''Warfare'''''
* '''[[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Leges Building]]''':  '''''Burning Abyss''''' (from Hall of Legends)
* '''Faction Unlock Requirements''': None (All Vanilla Factions are enabled by default)

== Unique Buildings ==
[[File:Demon_Unique_Building_Design.png|thumb|left]]
[[File:Special-building-demon.png|right|190x190px]]
[[File:Burning Abyss.png|right]]
At R16, the Demon's ''Hell Portals'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Infernal Realm''''', which is required for some [[challenges]] and [[research]] quests. 

At R100, the Demon's ''Hall of Legends'' can be upgraded to a [[Buildings#Unique Buildings|Unique Building]]: '''''Burning Abyss''''', which when bought will grant access to the [[Faction Union]] upgrade.{{Clr}}

== Demon Research ==
[[File:Research-new-progress-system-msg.PNG|right|250px]]
Upon reaching R16, the game advisor tells us that the Vanilla factions have gained tremendous power. Their power can be ours if we get ready and seek them again. 

To unlock Demon research, play the Demon faction and simply follow the appearing quests (Do not [[prestige]]). These can be done in separate game plays.
